comparison.objective: Paint a clean cut-in line above a skirting board using a guided paint edger.
comparison.physical_skill: Maintain guide-wheel contact and tool attitude while translating a loaded applicator along an edge.
comparison.success_condition: Coverage reaches the required length and boundary accuracy without paint on the skirting or unacceptable gaps, drips, or smears.
comparison.reason: Continuous guided coating application tests contact-path control, not fastener torque, collar setting, or repeated impact-response tuning.
